description_en: Queries the current list of name servers for a domain name and determines whether the servers are managed by Alibaba Cloud DNS
description_zh: 根据传入域名获取域名当前的NS服务器列表，以及NS是否属于阿里云解析管理
name: DescribeDomainNs

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values: zh: Chinese
en: English
Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh：中文       
en：英文           

默认取值为zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The domain name.<props="china"> You can call the DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29751.html) operation to obtain this value.</props>
<props="intl">You can call the DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/latest/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains) operation to obtain this value.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
域名名称。<props="china">可通过调取DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调取DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取</props>

AllAliDns.description_en: Indicates whether all name servers are Alibaba Cloud DNS servers
AllAliDns.description_zh: 是否全部为阿里云解析DNS

DetectFailedReasonCode.description_en: The error code returned if the detection fails

IncludeAliDns.description_en: Indicates whether the list of name servers includes Alibaba Cloud DNS servers
